svg.title: MORTAR: The MOlecule fRagmenTAtion fRamework: in silico fragmentation of whole compound sets. A fragmentation workstation that runs MORTAR's workflow left to right. A magazine holds a compound set of molecule cards and feeds them one by one; a punch turret carries the four algorithm dies and runs a two-step pipeline, Sugar Removal Utility then Scaffold Generator on its fragments; fragments are sorted into rows that form a horizontal histogram, beside a light table for the overview and a board for the items; a printer issues result cards in MORTAR's export formats.
